description_excerpt: Job Description ABOUT YOUR ROLE The Technology Technician serves as the primary technical liaison between Production and cross-functional teams, including Prepress, Sample Development, and Planning. This role is responsible for overseeing technical operational matters, such as process efficiency, sample specifications, and machinery setup. Additionally, the position provides technical consultation across departments and actively participates in New Product Introduction (NPI) and process improvement projects.
